## Cert expiry reminder - 3 things to fill in

**1. Confluence access** - open *Fetch Cert List Page* and set *Credential for Basic Auth* to a credential with your Atlassian **email** as user and an **API token** as password (create one at id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens).

**2. Teams, pick one or more (all three are wired):**
- *Incoming Webhook* - Teams channel > ... > Connectors > Incoming Webhook > paste the URL into that node.
- *Channel* - select a Microsoft Teams (OAuth2) credential, then pick Team + Channel.
- *1:1 Chat* - same credential (must be delegated OAuth2, not app-only), then pick the chat.

**3. Message wording** - edit *Parse Validity End & Build Reminder*: `WARN_DAYS` (60) and `ACTION_STEPS` at the top.

Leave only the Teams branches you actually want - delete or disable the others.

Trigger is manual for now; enable the schedule node when ready. Timezone is Asia/Singapore (set it in workflow settings too).

nodes.notes: Power Automate 'Send webhook alerts to a channel' trigger URL. The ?sig= signature is the whole credential - treat it as a secret. Content-Type must declare charset=utf-8 or the trigger decodes the body as ISO-8859-1 and emoji/middots arrive as ?? and Â·. Returns 202 Accepted.

nodes.name: Build Failure Notice
nodes.notes: Runs when the page fetch or the parser fails. Emits the same fields the send nodes expect (hasAlerts, subject, teamsText, teamsHtml, teamsWebhookPayload) so a failure is reported through the same channel instead of the run dying silently.

messageValues.message: You triage an internal TLS certificate inventory. Each row is a certificate whose VALIDITY END cell could not be trusted automatically. Buckets: no-environment = the ENV column is empty; unreadable-date = the cell has no parseable date; expired-long-ago = a date more than 12 months in the past; duplicate-row = the same row appears twice on the page. For EVERY row given return an entry with: id (copy it exactly), interpretation (what the cell most likely means, max 90 chars), probableDate (yyyy-mm-dd only if the cell text supports it, otherwise an empty string), confidence (low, medium or high), action (one short imperative instruction for the owner, max 80 chars). Never invent a date the text does not support - prefer an empty probableDate with low confidence. Answer with JSON only.

nodes.name: Interpret Rows (Ollama)
nodes.notes: Best effort. If Ollama is down this node errors and its error output continues to Merge AI Notes, so delivery never depends on the model. One call for the whole list, local model only - nothing leaves the machine.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.notes: Model name must exist locally: ollama pull llama3.1:8b

nodes.name: Merge AI Notes
nodes.notes: Rebuilds emailSubject / emailHtml / teamsWebhookPayload with the model's reading. Also receives the chain's error output, where it falls back to a plain 'model unavailable' note.

nodes.name: Ollama Reachable?
nodes.notes: Cheap probe so a laptop without Ollama skips the AI step instead of erroring on every run. Error output goes to the same IF, where the condition is simply false.
